units.source_text: 在古神社、古寺院甚多的京都，可以说几乎每天都要举行大大小小的节日。

en.t: In Kyoto, where there are many old shrines and ancient temples, it could be said that festivals large and small are held almost every day.

units.source_text: 翻开日历，整个五月，不是这儿就是那儿，总有热闹可看。

en.t: Open the calendar, and throughout the whole of May, there is always something lively to see somewhere or other.
